zone:brackenv.name: Brackenvale
zone:brackenv.story: Three fronts trouble a gentle vale. The dead are rising, and that is the main thread through the zone. Frogmen raid the coast and have already destroyed a village. A bandit gang in several camps preys on the Ashbys and on Riverwatch.
fronts: frogmen (amphen) incursion along the coast, a village destroyed
bandits in several camps, plaguing the Ashby farm and Riverwatch
zone:brackenv.note: Camps in layout.json were sketched before the story; rework them to fit the fronts.
zone:brackenv.undead: Several barrows across Brackenvale, raised by a rogue necromancer. At the end of the local chain we learn the necromancer is not alone: they belong to an underground cult in Thornwood.
zone:brackenv.frogmen: The frogmen destroyed a fishing village by the mouth of the lake's outflow, south-west of Saltwick, and hold the ruin. Saltwick is under attack and holding out.
zone:brackenv.bandits: Human bandits, a new creature set to make with the make-creature skill: at least a melee bandit, an archer and a leader, levels about 4 to 10.
zone:brackenv.mine: Kobold side story. Their mine broke into the side of a barrow, and now they are fighting the undead inside it. The necromancer is not directly involved: his rituals passively animate the dead within range, and this barrow is in range without his knowing it.
zone:brackenv.necromancer: A rogue necromancer, he, performing rituals that passively animate the dead near him. Part of an underground cult in Thornwood, which the end of the local chain reveals.
zone:brackenv.barrows: Four barrows, kept 1,700 ft or more from hubs because the dead wander toward the living: the mine barrow, Ashby barrow, Southwood barrow and River barrow, all within about 5,000 ft of the tower.
zone:brackenv.banditCamps: Two camps in the western hills near the gap raid the Ashby farm; two in the autumn wood prey on Riverwatch and its road; the chief hides in a fifth camp between them.
zone:brackenv.progression: Glen camp (1-5; you leave at about 5-6) -> Ashby farm (5-7: the kobold mine chain, field pests, hill bandits, the dead chain's farm entry) -> Lakeford (6-8, main town: the dead chain's town entry) -> in any order, 7-10: Saltwick (frogmen), Riverwatch (autumn bandits and their chief), the barrows and the tower (end of the dead chain) -> Pass gate (9-10, a few quests pointing on to Greyspur).
zone:brackenv.questCount: Aim for about 55: a large zone gives 40 to 65, and this one has six hubs, with Lakeford giving the most. The four chains come to about 28 quests, so the training glen and side quests make up the other 27 or so.
zone:brackenv.training: The training glen has 13 quests, by level 2, 2, 2, 3 and 4 for levels 1 to 5, matching the six reference starting areas (11 to 14 quests, about 12.5). About 3,800 quest XP of the 7,600 to level 6; about 60 kills along the way make the rest, so players leave at about 5.5 to 6. Two are set: the stolen supplies (bandits) and the level 5 breadcrumb to Ashby farm for the mine chain. Compose these with extra care: they are the first touch. They may include a few short chains.

zone:thornwoo.name: Thornwood
zone:thornwoo.story: An underground necromancer cult works in Thornwood, and the zone has an internal conflict of its own, still to be decided.
zone:thornwoo.hook: Brackenvale's undead chain ends by pointing here.

chain:undead.name: The rising dead
chain:undead.summary: The main chain. Starts from two tributary quests, one at Ashby farm and one at Lakeford; the chain needs either. Both name the chain's first quest as their next, so finishing either opens it. Runs through the barrows to the broken tower and the rogue necromancer, and ends on the hint that he belongs to an underground cult in Thornwood.
steps: Way in a, Ashby farm (kill): kill risen dead wandering near the Ashby barrow.
Way in b, Lakeford (bring): the town watch wants bones from risen dead seen at the town's edge.
1. The open barrow (use): look at the Ashby barrow's door stone, opened from inside. From here mostly from a priest in Lakeford.
2. Barrow earth (gather): gather earth from the Southwood barrow, for the priest to read where the power comes from.
3. Lights in the hills (talk): the reading points north-east; talk to Riverwatch's captain, who has seen lights at the broken tower.
4. The river barrow (bring): take a ritual charm from its dead.
5. Break the circle (use, several): smash ritual stones in the hills round the tower.
6. The necromancer (kill): kill him in the broken tower.
7. His journal (bring): bring it back to Lakeford; it names the cult in Thornwood.

chain:frogmen.name: The frogmen
chain:frogmen.summary: Starts with Saltwick needing help. You are sent to the ruined village, told what happened there, maybe as a rescue, but there are no survivors. Then it turns to saving Saltwick from the frogmen.
steps: 1. Saltwick needs help (talk): a messenger in Lakeford sends you to Saltwick.
2. The silent village (reach): the village down the shore went quiet; go look for survivors. There are none, only the wreckage.
3. What's left (gather): bring back keepsakes from the ruins for the families in Saltwick.
4. The siege line (kill): drive back the frogmen pressing on Saltwick.
5. Who leads them (bring): bring back their totems, which point to a tidecaller.
6. The tidecaller (kill): kill the tidecaller at his huts on the shore west of the ruined village.

chain:bandits.name: The bandit gang
chain:bandits.summary: The bandits are introduced in the training glen: they have stolen supplies from Glen camp, and you get them back. The chain proper starts at Westhill farmstead, by the western hills; another quest leads you there, but it is not required. Ends at the chief's hideout.
steps: Glen camp (bring): get back the supplies the glen thieves stole.
Breadcrumb, optional (talk): Ashby farm sends you to Westhill farmstead.
1. Fences down (kill): drive off the hill gap bandits, levels 5-6.
2. Seed for spring (bring): bring back the stolen seed sacks from the Westhill bandits.
3. Signed orders (talk): a bandit carries orders signed by a chief that mention Riverwatch; take them to Riverwatch's captain.
4. The Riverwatch road (kill): clear the autumn wood bandits off the road, levels 7-8.
5. The ledger (use): search their camp for a ledger that shows where the chief hides.
6. The chief (kill): kill him at his hideout, levels 9-10.

chain:kobolds.name: The kobold mine
chain:kobolds.summary: The earliest chain. Given at Ashby farm; its first quest needs level 5. Glen camp sends you to Ashby farm for it before you head on to Lakeford. The kobolds' mine broke into a barrow, and they are fighting its dead.
steps: 1. Stolen stores (bring): kobolds driven out of the mine raid the Ashbys' stores; get back sacks of grain from the kobolds at the mine mouth.
2. What drove them out (reach): go into the mine and reach the deep tunnel, where kobolds fight skeletons.
3. The old barrow (talk): someone old in the Ashby family remembers a barrow under that hill.
4. The barrow lord (kill): fight the barrow's lord to clear the barrow.
5. Consecrate the barrow (use): consecrate the cleared barrow, warding it against the ritual. The hint at the necromancer comes in this quest's text, or in something the lord drops.
